builders.name: Swyx
builders.summary_en: The Astra launch drew criticism for an ad that should have been caught before release, even though the model itself appears to be a solid incremental improvement. Separately, project-specific agents now retain their own memory across sessions and can coordinate when needed.

slang.definition_en: Information retained or surfaced across separate conversations or work sessions.

builders.name: Josh Woodward
builders.summary_en: Gemini's task-completion feature is now free in six countries, aiming to handle everyday tasks when users are busy. The team is asking people to share what they have delegated to it.

keywords.definition_zh: 指事情不断积压，越堆越多。

tweets.text:
Reply back with tasks that Gemini did for you! 
https://t.co/CEwsM02goB

Gemini can now do your tasks free of charge in six countries! We’ve built it for anyone who has tasks piling up during all the classes, meetings, and school drop-offs that fill the day. Our goal is for Gemini to get the job done and save you time and money along the way.

3 major updates:

1) Running on our new Gemini 4 Hydrogen model, Gemini can get stuff done at no cost for hundreds of millions of people across the US, Japan, Korea, Canada, Australia, and India.

2) Many highly requested features are rolling out now, starting in the US:
* Call local businesses (via Google Duplex)
* Pay and check out (via Google Pay)
* Text Gemini on Android or iOS (via RCS)
* Forward emails to Gemini (via Gmail)
* Sign into sites without sharing passwords outside Google (via Google Password Manager)

3) We’ve also landed our biggest update yet for the Gemini <> Google Workspace integration. The tools trigger more reliably, and you can do much more without ever leaving Gemini. Draft or send emails. Create and edit Docs or Sheets. Add multiple Calendar events at once.

Ready to hand off your next task? We can’t wait to see what Gemini crosses off your list first.
tweets.summary_en: Gemini is rolling out free task execution powered by Gemini 4 Hydrogen in six countries, with features starting in the US for business calls, checkout, texting, email forwarding, and secure website sign-ins. Its upgraded Workspace integration also supports more reliable email, document, spreadsheet, and calendar actions.

builders.name: Thibault Sottiaux
builders.summary_en: Sol 6.2 ultrafast feels markedly quicker for eligible Pro users, with broader access planned over time. Early reviewers may have tested an older build because substantial changes landed in the final days before release.
builders.summary_zh: 符合条件的 Pro 用户可体验速度明显更快的 Sol 6.2 ultrafast，未来计划扩大覆盖。早期测评者可能测试的是旧版本，因为发布前几天模型又有较大改动。

slang.definition_en: The subjective feel of using a model, such as speed, style, and responsiveness.
slang.definition_zh: 使用模型时对速度、风格和响应方式的主观感受。

keywords.definition_zh: 指某种体验格外畅快、令人兴奋。
keywords.example_zh: 他用这个口语表达形容 Sol ultrafast 的使用体验，强调速度提升带来的畅快感。

tweets.text: If you have Pro 200/500, I do recommend trying out 6.2 Sol ultrafast, it's quite the blast to use and a completely different feel. I'm excited to keep pushing in bringing these speeds to more users over time.

One of the funny reasons for the difference in vibes between the influencers and the crowd today on 6.2 Sol/Astra is that we gave a few folks access a while ago and then made a lot of changes in the last 3-4 days and I'm pretty sure no re-testing was done within those days and the videos were produced last week.

Don't get me wrong, while the models are a hefty jump compared to their GPT predecessors, they are by no means perfect and there are a few things the teams are excited for the models to get better at in future iterations in terms of taste and niceness of use. Love all the feedback and we hear you!
tweets.summary_en: Differences between influencer reviews and public reactions to 6.2 Sol/Astra may reflect substantial changes made in the final days before launch, after review videos were produced. The models are described as a major improvement over their GPT predecessors, with further work needed on taste and usability.

builders.name: Amjad Masad
builders.summary_en: Running many agents in parallel could improve software performance by letting them explore competing approaches. This frames agent coordination as another way to scale AI capability beyond larger models and longer reasoning.

keywords.example_zh: 他把智能体群视为 AI 扩展的新方向，认为增加并行工作的智能体数量也能提升能力。

keywords.definition_zh: 指多个计算任务或工作流程同时进行。
keywords.example_zh: 多个智能体同时尝试不同方法，是他提出的软件优化思路的核心。

tweets.text: How scaling agent swarms can optimize software performance. https://t.co/RbOtj6u9aQ

Agent swarms are the next scaling frontier for AI.

For years, we’ve scaled intelligence by training larger models and giving them more time to think. But there’s another dimension: running many agents in parallel, exploring different approaches, challenging each other, and working together on solutions that no single agent could easily discover.

OpenAI has already demonstrated the potential of this approach with breakthroughs in mathematics.

Until now, experimenting with agent swarms yourself required building complicated orchestration infrastructure.

Starting today on Replit, spinning up a swarm of agents is just one prompt away.

Excited to see what people discover when we make collective machine intelligence programmable by anyone.
tweets.summary_en: Parallel agent swarms offer another way to scale AI capabilities by exploring competing approaches and collaborating on solutions. Replit now lets users launch a swarm with a single prompt, removing the need to build complex orchestration infrastructure.

vocab.example_en: Porting the app to another operating system required changes to its interface.
vocab.example_zh: 将应用移植到另一个操作系统需要修改其界面。

quote.text_en: Well done is better than well said.
quote.author: Benjamin Franklin

slang_glossary.definition_en: Information carried or made available across separate AI sessions.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 跨不同 AI 会话保留或提供的上下文信息。

slang_glossary.definition_en: An informal impression of a model's behavior and quality.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 对模型表现和质量的主观直觉感受。

slang_glossary.definition_en: Groups of AI agents working together on tasks.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 共同执行任务的一组 AI 智能体。

slang_glossary.definition_en: Metrics used to assess aspects of website user experience.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 用于衡量网站用户体验各方面表现的指标。

slang_glossary.definition_en: Software that adjusts itself to improve performance or outcomes.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 能够自行调整以改善性能或结果的软件。

slang_glossary.definition_en: Infrastructure supporting autonomous AI agents.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 支持自主 AI 智能体运行的基础设施。

slang_glossary.definition_en: An isolated environment for running or testing code.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 用于运行或测试代码的隔离环境。

slang_glossary.definition_en: Learning from new information over time while retaining prior knowledge.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 持续吸收新信息，同时保留已有知识的学习方式。

slang_glossary.definition_en: Completed successfully in a single attempt.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 一次尝试就成功完成了。

slang_glossary.definition_en: Input or instructions given to an AI model.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 提供给 AI 模型的输入或指令；提示词。

slang_glossary.definition_en: An AI model near the leading edge of current capabilities.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 能力接近当前技术前沿的 AI 模型。

slang_glossary.definition_en: Informal shorthand for a benchmark or benchmark evaluation.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: benchmark 的口语缩写，指基准测试或评测。

slang_glossary.definition_en: Achieving useful results with relatively few model tokens.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 以相对较少的模型词元获得有效结果的。

slang_glossary.term: saw this coming a mile away
slang_glossary.definition_en: Could easily predict what would happen.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 早就能明显预见到会发生什么。

slang_glossary.definition_en: Informally, dependable and good in quality.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 口语中指可靠、质量不错的。

slang_glossary.definition_en: Reinforcement learning, a training approach guided by rewards.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 强化学习，一种以奖励信号引导训练的方法。

slang_glossary.definition_en: Texting abbreviation for right now.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: right now 的聊天缩写，意为「现在」。

slang_glossary.definition_en: Using a tool regularly as one's main option.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 将某个工具作为主力日常使用。

slang_glossary.definition_en: Using software to execute sequences of work with reduced manual effort.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 利用软件执行连续工作步骤，减少人工操作。

slang_glossary.definition_en: In this context, repetitive agent behavior that fails to make progress.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 此处指智能体反复执行却无法推进任务的循环。

slang_glossary.definition_en: Processes that compress an agent's accumulated context.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 压缩智能体已积累上下文的操作。

slang_glossary.definition_en: Creating reusable instructions or procedures for an AI agent.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 为 AI 智能体编写可复用的指令或操作流程。

slang_glossary.definition_en: A connected sequence of steps for preparing and publishing content.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 用于准备和发布内容的一整套连续流程。

slang_glossary.definition_en: A business funded mainly through its founders and operating revenue.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 主要依靠创始人资金和经营收入发展的企业。

slang_glossary.definition_en: A store of information an agent can retrieve later.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 供智能体之后检索使用的信息存储库。

slang_glossary.definition_en: Multiple AI agents organized to collaborate.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 由多个 AI 智能体组成的协作团队。

slang_glossary.definition_en: Continuously available or operating.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 持续在线、可用或运行的。

slang_glossary.definition_en: Return on investment; benefits evaluated against the cost invested.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 投资回报，衡量收益与投入成本的关系。

slang_glossary.definition_en: Take responsibility for achieving results.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 对最终结果承担责任。

slang_glossary.definition_en: Informal shortening of collaborate or collaboration.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: collaborate 或 collaboration 的口语缩写，意为「协作」。

slang_glossary.definition_en: Agents delegated portions of work by another agent.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 接受其他智能体委派、负责部分工作的子智能体。

slang_glossary.definition_en: Outputs users can interact with, such as small apps or dashboards.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 用户可交互操作的产出，例如小应用或仪表盘。

slang_glossary.definition_en: A name used in the sample for interactive app outputs associated with Devin.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 样本中用于指代 Devin 相关交互式应用产出的名称。

slang_glossary.definition_en: In this context, shorthand apparently referring to an AI Engineer event.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 根据上下文推测，指某场 AI Engineer 活动的简称。

slang_glossary.definition_en: In this context, likely answer engine optimization: improving visibility in AI-generated answers.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 根据上下文推测，指「答案引擎优化」，即提高内容在 AI 生成答案中的可见度。

slang_glossary.definition_en: Quality assurance: checking that a product meets expected standards.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 质量保证：检查产品是否达到预期标准。

slang_glossary.definition_en: Adapting an application to run on different platforms.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 将应用移植到不同平台上运行。

slang_glossary.definition_en: A joking complaint about the difficulty of managing many Git working trees.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 戏称管理大量 Git 工作树时的混乱和麻烦。

slang_glossary.definition_en: Texting abbreviation for of course.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: of course 的聊天缩写，意为「当然」。

slang_glossary.definition_en: Heavily promoted or surrounded by excitement.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 被大力宣传、炒热或引发高度兴奋的。

slang_glossary.definition_en: A slash-command label mentioned as a way to direct goal-based agent work; its exact behavior is unspecified.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 文中提到的目标导向智能体工作斜杠命令，其具体行为未说明。

slang_glossary.definition_en: Labels mentioned for intensified coding or agent operation; their exact behavior is unspecified.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 文中提到的强化编码或智能体运行模式名称，具体行为未说明。

slang_glossary.definition_en: Designing repeated agent execution and feedback cycles to pursue a goal.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 设计智能体反复执行与接收反馈的循环，以推进目标。
